source: User screenshot and explicit attack-count reply

model.timing: Configured attacks occur on the same wave boss while Golden Arrows is active, followed by one final kill payout. No attack-speed or cooldown averaging.
model.firstAttack: Zero prior consecutive-hit stacks; an interpretation of consecutive attacks, not a separately confirmed in-game measurement.
model.passiveKillGold: Global and selected attacker personal Kill Gold milestones, synergies, Grand Master factors and Kill Gold tile. Excludes the separately calibrated Rogue and Hunter on-kill factors.
model.combinedScore: Existing final boss-kill index plus generated gold on the same normalized base-gold scale.
model.unconfirmedInteractions: Super/Ultra reward tiers, chance spillover, and Rogue/Hunter/Sovereign conditional on-kill skills are not applied to generated gold because their applicability is unconfirmed. The final kill still receives them normally.
model.skillTile: Continue the previously confirmed 1.20 multiplier for active and mastery bonuses, local to the selected Crusader. This new screenshot's tile state was not separately confirmed; treat its values as the editable no-tile baseline.
model.fixedCalibration: Captured totals are held fixed across candidate teams. Do not reapply account, milestone, synergy, GM, event or generic Skill Power boosts.
model.ownership: Only the selected Crusader generates attack gold. Support copies do not contribute attacks or lend their skill-tile boost.
